purpose: Implemented capabilities and their public source routes. Evaluation coverage is separate from implementation status.

capabilities.implementation: Canonical baseline and terminology records shared across independently installable skills.
Eleven purpose-specific skills with concern-specific local references and an explicit compatibility chooser.
Evidence gaps, actual blockers and authorised work are distinguished in tasks, decisions and handoffs.
Optional revision records expose consequential edits, their reasons and retained source constraints.
Attributed local patterns have stable IDs, source-constrained examples and contextual exceptions. A generator checks the readable reference for drift.
A canonical catalogue generates overview pages and presentation metadata without rewriting activation descriptions.
Persistent instruction examples and a bounded Codex Stop adapter are separate from skill installation.

evaluation_coverage.deterministic_checks: Package structure, canonical-reference consistency, catalogue generation, registry validation and bounded adapter behaviour.
evaluation_coverage.agent_cases: Recorded selection, source-discovery, writing, architecture and uncertainty cases; see validation-results.md for inputs and scope.
evaluation_coverage.human_readers: No human-comprehension result is included in the published evaluation.
evaluation_coverage.native_clients: Documented integration routes are distinguished from observed native activation.
evaluation_coverage.comparison: The competing-writing-skills source review is not a comparative prose-quality benchmark.
